messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rategate-service v2 -> prod (canary 10%)
oncall-bot: Pager triggered: high 429 rate in eu-west-1 (severity: high) :rotating_light:
chris: I'm on it, @maya you free to triage? seeing 429 spikes on token-limited routes
maya: yes, taking a look. Graphs show a sharp jump at 17:03 UTC, coincident with the canary rollout. Possibly exemption list not applied to v2
leah: Support reports customers in EU hitting "quota exceeded" errors and opening tickets. Customer IDs: C-1337, C-20. Marking P1 for now
alex: Can we flip the feature flag for the rollout to stop traffic to v2? flag is `feature.rategate.v2_enabled`
devon: I can flip. Preparing to run the kill-switch. Will announce before flip.
chris: Also check token accounting service logs for 429->token_charge mismatch. last seen a negative delta on token ledger entries.
oncall-bot: Assigning to chris (eng-oncall) and maya (sre). Escalate to oncall paging group.
maya: quick log snippet from token-acc (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T17:03:22Z ERROR token-acc - charge failed user=U1234 delta=-1.0 reason=missing_exemption
2026-03-15T17:03:23Z WARN rategate - exemption lookup returned 0 for account=C-1337
```
maya: looks like exemption table reference changed (schema v2) but v2 rollout still reads old key `exemptions.key` -> mismatch
devon: confirmed. The deploy altered the exemption key name. v2 queries `exemptions_v2` which is empty in prod for some customers.
chris: OK kill-switch now. devon: go ahead when ready. Post the exact command you run.
devon: running:
```
# disable new rategate routing for canary
curl -X POST https://console.internal/flags/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"flag":"feature.rategate.v2_enabled","value":false}'
```
devon: done. flag flipped. Routing reverted to v1 for canary cohort. :white_check_mark:
maya: traffic dropping back to v1, 429s decreasing. Metrics:
- 17:04:10 UTC 99th latency spike cleared
- 17:05:05 UTC 429 rate down 85%
leah: Support: customers reporting errors resolved. Ticket owners notified. Will follow up with affected list.
chris: Immediate mitigation complete. Root cause: deploy introduced config/schema mismatch for exemption lookup causing missing exemptions -> over-throttling + token-accounting negative delta. Impact: select customers in eu-west-1 saw quota enforcement and token accounting anomalies for ~2m.
maya: Action items: rollback v2 fully, add schema validation in deploy pipeline, add unit test for exemption key mapping, add a canary-stage integration that queries exemption store.
devon: Rollback planned: 17:10 UTC full roll back of rategate v2. Schedule it and notify.
deploy-bot: Rollback started by devon at 17:10 UTC. Canary removed, rolling back to v1 across regions.
oncall-bot: Handing off to postmortem channel and eng-sre. @chris please create initial incident doc and tag postmortem.
chris: Will create incident doc in #postmortems and link to this thread. Preliminary impact: ~12 customers saw 429s, 3 escalated to support P1. No data loss. Duration ~7m from first spike to full rollback.
leah: I'll prepare customer communication drafts + list of affected accounts and timestamps.
alex: Noting that our feature flag platform doesn't currently gate schema changes. Need to add a preflight validator for config changes.
maya: capture logs and snapshots for the postmortem. I'm exporting metrics and will attach to the doc.
chris: Good work team. We'll convene a 30-min blameless triage at 18:00 UTC. tagging @all oncall for follow-up. :coffee:
support-bot: Created ticket SUP-4421 for customer C-1337, linked to incident 2487654321
deploy-bot: Incident closed for now (mitigated). Follow-up tasks assigned. Please update the postmortem with timeline and code references.
